title: Not 68oz.
text: Not 68oz.. Like that this is short enough to fit in the microwave, but it is NOT 68oz.  It is about 56oz. to 58oz.. I ordered two 68oz. pitchers, but I knew as soon as I took this out of the box it was smaller. Nice except for that.

product_metadata.title: Hedume 2 Liter 68 Ounces Glass Pitcher with Lid, Large Heat Resistant Glass Beverage Pitcher, Glass Water Pitcher with Lid and Handle, Carafe for Iced Tea, Wine, Coffee, Milk and Juice Beverage
features: Handcrafted by Craftsman - The pitcher is hand blown true borosilicate glass with graceful modern lines by professional craftsman.
Premium Borosilicate Glass Pitcher - Lead-free, lightweight, durable, stove-top safe, withstands temperature 0 ℉ to 300 ℉, so you can pour boiling water into it safely.

SUS 304 Stainless Steel Lid - Anti-drip spout,Convenient to pour and easy to clean. The handle is big and comfortable to hold. Baby safe & Medical safe rubber part arround the lid makes the lid close tightly, keeping the water inside fresh and the lid not falling off when pouring.
Wash Easily - Dishwasher safe, but hand wash is recommended. Big mouth on the top can let your hand reach the bottom easily,making the inside cleaning become very convenient and easy.

Large Capacity - 2 liter 68 ounces, large enough to serve your family for daily drink or entertain guests at the party. Fits well in most fridges. Perfect to prepare and serve cold or hot beverages, water, wine, coffee, iced tea, fruit infused juices.
